# Schema reference

Schema version **1.0.0**. Publisher prefix `pplf`, choice value prefix `91700`.

The same columns exist in Dataverse and SharePoint, so you can switch the log target without changing reports or queries.

## Log levels

| Level | Severity | Choice value |
|---|---|---|
| Trace | 0 | 917000000 |
| Debug | 1 | 917000001 |
| Information | 2 | 917000002 |
| Warning | 3 | 917000003 |
| Error | 4 | 917000004 |
| Critical | 5 | 917000005 |

## PPLF Log (`pplf_log`)

One row per log entry written by any Power Platform component.

SharePoint list: **PPLF Logs** (URL `/Lists/PPLFLogs`)

| Display name | Dataverse column | Type | SharePoint field | SP type | Indexed | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Title | `pplf_name` | Text(200) | `Title` | Text | | First 200 characters of the message. |
| Level | `pplf_level` | Choice (`pplf_loglevel`) * | `PplfLevel` | Choice | yes |  |
| Severity | `pplf_severity` | Integer * | `PplfSeverity` | Number | yes | 0=Trace ... 5=Critical. Duplicates Level as a number so both stores filter the same way. |
| Source Type | `pplf_sourcetype` | Choice (`pplf_sourcetype`) * | `PplfSourceType` | Choice | yes |  |
| Source Name | `pplf_sourcename` | String(200) * | `PplfSourceName` | Text | yes | App, flow, site or plug-in name. |
| Component | `pplf_component` | String(200) | `PplfComponent` | Text |  | Screen, control, flow step, page or class. |
| Operation | `pplf_operation` | String(200) | `PplfOperation` | Text |  | What was being attempted, e.g. SubmitExpense. |
| Message | `pplf_message` | Memo(4000) * | `PplfMessage` | Note |  |  |
| Details (JSON) | `pplf_details` | Memo(100000) | `PplfDetails` | Note |  | Structured context as JSON. Never put secrets or personal data here. |
| Correlation Id | `pplf_correlationid` | String(100) | `PplfCorrelationId` | Text | yes | Shared by every entry that belongs to one user action across apps, flows and plug-ins. |
| Session Id | `pplf_sessionid` | String(100) | `PplfSessionId` | Text |  |  |
| User | `pplf_userprincipalname` | String(320) | `PplfUser` | Text |  |  |
| Environment | `pplf_environment` | String(100) | `PplfEnvironment` | Text |  |  |
| App Version | `pplf_appversion` | String(50) | `PplfAppVersion` | Text |  |  |
| Run Url | `pplf_runurl` | String(500) | `PplfRunUrl` | Text |  | Link to the flow run or page that produced the entry. |
| Duration (ms) | `pplf_durationms` | Integer | `PplfDurationMs` | Number |  |  |
| Error Code | `pplf_errorcode` | String(100) | `PplfErrorCode` | Text |  |  |
| Client Timestamp | `pplf_clienttimestamp` | DateTime | `PplfClientTimestamp` | DateTime | yes | When the event happened on the client (UTC). Created On is when it was stored. |
| Client Info | `pplf_clientinfo` | String(500) | `PplfClientInfo` | Text |  | Device, browser or runtime. |

\* required

## PPLF Log Configuration (`pplf_logconfig`)

Per-source logging settings. A row named * is the default for every source.

SharePoint list: **PPLF Log Config** (URL `/Lists/PPLFLogConfig`)

| Display name | Dataverse column | Type | SharePoint field | SP type | Indexed | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Source Name | `pplf_name` | Text(200) | `Title` | Text | | Must match the Source Name sent by the app or flow, or * for the default. |
| Source Type | `pplf_sourcetype` | Choice (`pplf_sourcetype`) | `PplfSourceType` | Choice |  |  |
| Minimum Level | `pplf_minimumlevel` | Choice (`pplf_loglevel`) * | `PplfMinimumLevel` | Choice |  |  |
| Minimum Severity | `pplf_minimumseverity` | Integer * | `PplfMinimumSeverity` | Number |  | Numeric copy of Minimum Level used by flows. |
| Enabled | `pplf_enabled` | Boolean | `PplfEnabled` | Boolean |  |  |
| Retention (days) | `pplf_retentiondays` | Integer | `PplfRetentionDays` | Number |  | Entries older than this are deleted by the retention flow. |
| Notes | `pplf_notes` | Memo(2000) | `PplfNotes` | Note |  |  |

\* required

## Environment variables

| Schema name | Type | Default | Allowed | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pplf_LogTarget` | String | `Dataverse` | Dataverse, SharePoint, Both | Where routed logs are written: Dataverse, SharePoint or Both. |
| `pplf_DefaultMinimumLevel` | String | `Information` | Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical | Used when no config row matches a source and there is no * row. |
| `pplf_DefaultRetentionDays` | Number | `30` |  | Used by the retention flow when no config row sets retention. |
| `pplf_AlertMinimumLevel` | String | `Critical` | Warning, Error, Critical, None | Entries at or above this level trigger an email alert. None turns alerts off. |
| `pplf_AlertRecipients` | String |  |  | Semicolon-separated email addresses for alerts. |
| `pplf_SharePointSite` | DataSource |  |  | Site that holds the PPLF lists. Only needed when Log Target is SharePoint or Both. |
| `pplf_SharePointLogList` | DataSource |  |  | The PPLF Logs list (stored as the list id). |
| `pplf_SharePointConfigList` | DataSource |  |  | The PPLF Log Config list (stored as the list id). |

## Security roles

**PPLF Log Writer**: Lets apps, flows and pages run by this user write log entries and read logging settings. Give it to every app user.

- `pplf_log`: Create (Global)
- `pplf_logconfig`: Read (Global)

**PPLF Log Administrator**: Read and delete logs, and manage logging settings.

- `pplf_log`: Create, Read, Delete (Global)
- `pplf_logconfig`: Create, Read, Write, Delete (Global)
